previews.recommended_input: 一款便携净水器，面向户外徒步者：先展示喝到清水的结果，再依次用滤芯剖面、浑水变清和营地实用场景证明功能，最后出现简短购买行动。

previews.label: 产品证据变体｜场景结果到机理再回人群
previews.short_summary: 从人群结果切到产品身份，再给出一次清楚的材质或机理证明，返回更广的人群结果并以稳定产品终态收束；复用既有产品证据状态机。
previews.recommended_input: 办公室先显示空气问题，再独立展示净化器；微距证明滤芯截留颗粒，回到放松人群，最后以设备、旧滤芯与清洁气流同框收束。
required_anchors: Establish one emotionally readable outcome related to the product.
Isolate the product identity before technical proof.
Return to a broader result state after proof.
End on a clean stable product state.

previews.label: 结果先行广告｜终态承诺倒推证据
previews.short_summary: 先亮出清楚可读的理想结果，再把产品隔离为因果对象；用紧凑的材质或身份证据连接产品与使用状态，最后放宽到真实生活结果并停留。该案只作为既有产品证据状态机的证据变体。
previews.recommended_input: 先展示护目镜带来的清晰航道结果，再倒推模块组装、佩戴与抗雾证明，最后回到佩戴者在河岸完成任务的稳定产品终态。
required_anchors: Show one desired outcome before explaining product operation.
Isolate one product as the causal anchor for that outcome.
Widen from product-dominant proof into the lived context.
Hold the outcome long enough to read the relationship.

previews.label: 阳影护肤品证据链｜封装、质地、取用、涂抹与结果
previews.short_summary: 用同一暖阳、叶影和手部身份把封闭包装、开盖内料、质地取样、皮肤涂抹和最终静物串成一条证明链；每段只回答一个产品问题，所有实物动作先于对应短文案，结尾回到未移动的完整包装与清楚功能层级。
previews.recommended_input: 成年手在斜向工作室光中托住石墨玻璃罐，铜环、准确【ARC MEND】和【FILL THE LINE】清楚；钢刮刀只提取一道定量矿物膏，罐体仍在边缘；封闭 ARC MEND 与修复瓷砖同框，只显示【ARC MEND】和【FILL · LEVEL · CURE】
required_anchors: Establish one closed original product, one hand identity and one lighting signature.
Open the same container and reveal untouched contents before manipulation.
Transfer the measured amount to one application surface and show the complete spread.
Return to the complete closed pack and add only concise text supported by prior stages.

previews.label: 美容功效证据变体｜成年用户基线、取量、使用、触感与持瓶回扣
previews.short_summary: 同一明确成年用户先展示问题基线和产品，再用可见取量、单次使用、触感与动作结果逐级证明功效；最后回到同一脸、同一产品和稳定结果，避免只靠口播。
previews.recommended_input: 原创窗光下，一名明确成年皮革工匠与一只干燥开裂棕色工作靴、一个无标签磨砂护理瓶同时出现；脸、靴子和光线方向稳定。；不做跳切重置，她用保留的同一剂量连续三次擦过靴子左侧鞋头和侧片。；回到同一成年人持同一护理瓶站在靴子旁，处理区与未处理区同框可读；无标志、宣称和额外文字并停住。
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original user, one label-free product and a visible pre-use state in the same light.
Show a measured dose leaving the same product and arriving on a visible hand or tool.
Prove the result through touch, movement and consistent lighting rather than a disconnected beauty cut.
Return the same adult, product and treated state in one stable closing frame.

previews.label: 单物微距英雄片｜材质证据、轮廓确认与静态收束
previews.short_summary: 围绕单一产品做由近到远的材质证明：先展示操作件与高光，再逐步扩展到完整轮廓、底座反射和稳定英雄构图，全程不引入无关人物。
previews.recommended_input: 极近特写原创台灯的黄铜调光钮与斜切玻璃环。；在炭黑到琥珀渐变背景中居中展示完整台灯。；完整原创台灯进入对称英雄构图，以一圈暖边光停留，不出现文字。
required_anchors: One product remains the only hero object.
Evidence expands from control detail to full silhouette.
The reflective base confirms shape and finish.
The final centered frame holds long enough for recognition.

previews.label: 饮品欲望证明链｜包装出现、液体微距与饮用反馈
previews.short_summary: 让单一饮品包装先建立识别，再用原料微距、倒杯和真人饮用依次证明质地、流动与愉悦；最后以多包装阵列和短标语收束。
previews.recommended_input: 暖石台面先建立原创【VELA】燕麦可可纸盒。；VELA以一条连续液流倒入带棱透明杯。；三盒VELA与装满的玻璃杯组成终局，准确短句【SMOOTH ENERGY】停留。
required_anchors: The package is identified before ingredient spectacle.
Macro ingredients visibly relate to the beverage.
An adult user reaction follows the serving proof.
The final pack array and exact short line hold together.

previews.label: 宣讲到远端结果｜人物承诺、观众响应与设备证明
previews.short_summary: 用台上成年讲者提出行动承诺，切到观众的一次手机响应，再切到远端设备的稳定运行状态；三个空间通过同一功能因果而非随机蒙太奇连接。
previews.recommended_input: 成年能源工程师站在社区小型演讲台旁，准确原创标题【NIGHT SHIFT POWER】可读。；短暂回到工程师指向一张简单电流图，不增加不可见声明。；同一电池与持续点亮的台灯共同停留，让远端动作和可见结果闭环。
required_anchors: One speaker makes one bounded functional promise.
One audience action visibly initiates the next state.
A remote device changes state after that action.
The final frame proves the device result without unsupported metrics.

previews.label: 平面饮品证据链｜包装锚定、开启因果与倒杯落版
previews.short_summary: 用一个注册稳定的原创包装贯穿平面广告，开启动作先触发气泡与冰，随后倒杯证明液体状态，最后所有图形回收到完整包装与短标语。
previews.recommended_input: 象牙底建立原创钴蓝【CITRA】气泡水罐，平面轮廓稳定。；CITRA以一条连续液流倒入带棱透明杯。；完整罐体与满杯回收到准确原创短句【OPEN THE DAY】旁。
required_anchors: One registered package silhouette anchors every beat.
Graphic effects begin at visible package actions.
All copy is short, exact and readable.
The final lockup reunites package, serving and promise.

previews.label: 色材围绕产品成形｜液态环、粒子爆发与英雄复位
previews.short_summary: 让完整产品保持中心注册，颜色介质从小滴变成环、液池与粉雾，所有效果都由同一材质因果推进并在终局回收到清洁产品英雄镜头。
previews.recommended_input: 原创铜色香水瓶完整直立在炭黑舞台，轮廓清楚。；细环增厚为两层透明玻璃质折叠，瓶身标签始终无遮挡。；粒子全部沉入透明圆台，完整香水瓶与准确字样【AURA / 01】共同停留。
required_anchors: One registered product geometry anchors every state.
Material begins from one visible product-adjacent trigger.
Effects never obscure the product identity.
The clean lockup restores the complete product and one exact line.

previews.label: 食材到饮品状态链｜切开、取肉、搅打与倒杯证明
previews.short_summary: 让食材的每次不可逆操作直接产生下一状态，工具、容器和液体保持因果连续；终局必须同时展示原料、饮品和明确成品状态。
previews.recommended_input: 正面棚拍近景中，一刀切开原创琥珀星梨。；加入三块冰和一股定量浅茶，搅打成金色不透明饮品。；成年制作者、切开的梨、搅拌杯和成品杯停在准确短句【ONE CUT / GOLDEN READY】下。
required_anchors: One ingredient identity remains traceable.
Each irreversible operation causes the next state.
One viscosity proof precedes serving.
The final hero frame reunites source ingredient, process and serving.

previews.label: 洁面过程证据链｜包装、泵出、起泡、冲洗与肤感收束
previews.short_summary: 产品先与使用者同框建立承诺，再用泵出质地、面部起泡、水流冲洗、毛巾擦干和包装英雄镜头逐级完成可见证明。
previews.recommended_input: 成年野外医护在明亮移动诊所展示原创炭灰色手部清洁泵。；双手揉搓，薄泡沫覆盖手指与手背。；展示清洁结果，再让完整泵瓶与准确短句【READY TO RETURN】共同停留。
required_anchors: One product and one user remain fixed.
A measured dose precedes application.
Rinsing removes the applied material.
The final result returns to the complete product.

previews.label: 饮品感官跃迁｜搅拌基线、吸饮触发与包装回归
previews.short_summary: 同一杯饮品先在现实环境被搅拌和吸饮，吸管动作触发背景跃迁；人物体验后返回干净棚拍，并用完整杯身和短句完成产品回归。
previews.recommended_input: 成年天文馆向导在安静大厅搅拌原创紫色柑橘饮品。；吸饮期间只把背景变成缓慢星图穹顶和漂浮柑橘球。；重置到浅色摄影棚，完整原创杯放在黑玻璃台上，准确短句【TASTE THE NIGHT】停留。
required_anchors: One person and one cup remain registered.
A visible sip triggers the state change.
Reaction follows the completed sensory action.
The clean studio return restores the full package.

previews.label: 香气状态切换｜人群基线、喷洒触发、步态兑现与瓶身收束
previews.short_summary: 同一成年女性在拥挤电梯建立受限基线，拿出香水并完成一次喷洒；暖光状态随动作出现，她以稳定步态进入大厅，最后回到瓶身与人物共同英雄镜头。
previews.recommended_input: 成年博物馆馆长穿板岩套装站在拥挤服务电梯。；只向围巾喷一次，触发暖边光状态，身份与套装不变。；铜色瓶单独停留后，回连同一馆长举瓶，准确短句【ENTER CLEARLY】出现。
required_anchors: One adult identity and one product remain fixed.
The complete product is shown before use.
The changed state is proved by locomotion and environment response.
The final product shot reconnects to the same user.

previews.label: 食品分层证明｜完整基线、爆炸结构与英雄复位
previews.short_summary: 先展示完整食品，再把面包、蔬菜、奶酪和肉饼沿同一轴线拆成可读层级；用微距证明材质后按原顺序回装，终局恢复完整英雄镜头。
previews.recommended_input: 原创柑橘挞置于浅石桌中央，先清楚展示完整轮廓。；三次微距依次证明酥壳、轻盈奶油和反光镜面，不新增食材。；所有层按原顺序复位，完整柑橘挞与准确短句【MADE TO LIFT】共同停留。
required_anchors: The complete product is shown before decomposition.
Every separated layer remains registered to one axis.
Reassembly preserves the original order.
The final hero frame restores the complete product and one exact claim.

templates.creative_dna:
Reusable Creative DNA (mechanism and production grammar only):
A compressed launch film behaves as a flexible proof state machine rather than a fixed storyboard: an outcome, operation, internal mechanism, maximum contrast event, breadth proof and final action may be merged or reordered as long as each state answers a new product question. A strict material, light and typography system maintains coherence while shot count, information order, camera carrier and breadth device change across instances.
Invariants:
- inv-01: Within the first third, establish one emotionally legible outcome and its causal relationship to the product; outcome-first and proof-first openings are both valid.
- inv-02: Make each information state answer a different product question, but merge related questions and vary their order according to the new product's strongest causal proof.
- inv-03: Concentrate one maximum contrast event after enough setup to make it legible; the peak may be physical, spatial, typographic or human, and its position is variable.
- inv-04: Bind different modules with one strict contrast system, typography behavior and recurring assembly physics.
- inv-05: Prove breadth once before the final action using a device native to the new concept—continuous space, physical transformation, one montage, radial staging or audience behavior—not a mandatory card row or grid.
- inv-06: Keep all visible copy short, complete and motion-safe: text lands at final size on a cut or via a hard mask and remains sharp long enough to read.
Variable slots:
- product_identity: One original fictional product name and a single-sentence emotional promise.
- hero_benefit_image: An original person, object or environment showing the desired outcome rather than the interface.
- capability_modules: Two or three visually distinct proofs that answer different product questions.
- operation_proof: One legible control, process or physical mechanism that demonstrates how the product works.
- peak_event: One maximum contrast event expressed through physical, spatial, typographic or human change.
- breadth_device: One original non-redundant method for proving multiple contexts; avoid the source card-row plus grid pair.
- graphic_system: A palette, material, light behavior and typography rule unrelated to the source campaign.
- final_action: One concise CTA displayed in a stable closing lockup.
- information_order: Choose an order derived from the new product's causal logic, not the source's nine-state sequence.
- shot_structure: Use five to eight states with materially different boundaries, merges and camera implementations.
Failure prevention:
- The film is only a sequence of attractive product shots.: Assign each beat a distinct question and require an observable proof before the next cut.
- Every beat tries to be the visual climax.: Use restrained assembly motion early, one dominant kinetic peak, then simplify toward the CTA.
- Typography becomes unreadable or dominates the product.: Limit copy, land it complete at final size, hold it sharp and keep moving effects behind the text plane.
- A palette swap leaves the source campaign visibly recognizable.: Change product category, hero subject, materials, information order, shot count, camera implementation, breadth device, copy and final action in addition to color.
Do not copy from the source: MiniMax H3, HailuoAI, Create Beyond, LIVE RIGHT NOW, AVAILABLE NOW and every other source string; source woman, violet jellyfish, nebula, purple speed streaks and identical product-category imagery; source wordmarks, logos, translucent panel compositions, editing interface and creator-card layouts; the exact nine-panel storyboard, exact beat durations, exact typography positions and source color palette

h3.guidance: MiniMax H3 native adapter. Realize every required mechanism anchor as a concrete visible event inside the native H3 integrated description or Ref2VA detailed description. Preserve the exact H3 Base/Ref2VA field order, [Shot N] timeline, camera continuity, soundscape and music separation. Do not emit Seedance 镜头N or @图片N syntax. The case mechanism is lower priority than user intent, observable media, hard constraints, duration, fixed shot count, official H3 rules, official creative presets and a manual reference template.

seedance20.guidance: Seedance 2.0 native adapter. Realize every required mechanism anchor as a concrete filmable event inside one compact paragraph or consecutive 镜头N sequence chosen from the task complexity. Use Seedance subject binding, asset roles, coherent motion and sound syntax; never emit H3 field names, [Shot N], alignment lines or absolute per-shot time ranges. The case mechanism is lower priority than user intent, observable media, hard constraints, duration, fixed shot count, official Seedance rules and a manual reference template.

previews.label: 固定工坊｜平面珠阵逐层立体成型
previews.short_summary: 锁定同一工坊桌面与材料边界，让平面珠阵按不可逆阶段先形成局部图案、再升起主立体、补出次级物件与承托底座，最终以同一构图中的完整立体组合验收。
previews.recommended_input: 原创陶土地质工作台上，方形石墨模具内是一张完全平坦的奶油色等高图；黄铜卡尺、钴蓝釉杯和高度草图位置固定；中央圆环升成一座火山锥，邻近陶土按可数层级抬成梯田，保留真实压痕、裂纹和投影；深蓝玻璃只流入盆地并凝成反光湖，火山、梯田、仪器塔和湖泊完整位于原方模内，固定工具共同可见

Begin with a visibly flat or incomplete material field before any finished form appears.
Add irreversible height, secondary parts or support geometry in countable stages.

previews.label: 固定空间｜毛坯阶段生成完成室内
previews.short_summary: 在完全锁定的室内广角中保留门洞、窗户和墙体几何，用清理、表面完成、地板、家具与照明等不可逆阶段逐层兑现同一空间，最后让完成状态仍与开场结构直接对照。
previews.recommended_input: 原创轨道温室从空白白色压力框架开始，三道圆形舱环、一个深色观察窗、裸露地轨和设备安装点清楚；石墨冷却管和细青色灌溉线连接地面与墙面安装点，指示流只沿管线通过一次；暖色居住灯开启，一圈受控薄雾沿温室循环；膜墙、管线、作物、平台、舱环和观察窗共同可读
required_anchors: Lock one wide composition with at least three structural anchors visible for the full sequence.
Begin from an incomplete but readable shell and complete its base surfaces first.
Populate distinct zones with occupancy or operational components without blocking the spatial comparison.
Use one final activation proof and hold the complete state in the opening composition.

templates.creative_dna:
Reusable Creative DNA (mechanism and production grammar only):
A fixed composition turns creation into a readable causal ladder: low-commitment guides establish geometry, committed structure locks it, material finish adds specificity, contextual details certify completion, and one restrained in-medium motion supplies the final surprise.
Invariants:
- inv-01: Lock the camera and reserve stable spatial zones before any marks appear.
- inv-02: Progress from low-commitment guides to committed structure to material colour or finish.
- inv-03: Delay secondary labels, studies or context until the hero form is already readable.
- inv-04: End with one subtle motion that remains faithful to the finished medium while the support stays inert.
Variable slots:
- support: One stable physical or graphic surface with reserved hero and context zones.
- hero_subject: A single dominant form readable first as guides, then structure, then finish.
- representation_ladder: Three visibly distinct commitment stages appropriate to the chosen medium.
- context_details: Two to four secondary marks or diagrams that arrive only after the hero reads.
- finish_palette: A restrained palette that clarifies material stages.
- living_idle: One small loop or response that does not leave or volumize the surface.
- sound_ladder: Material sounds change with each process stage, followed by one payoff accent.
Failure prevention:
- All layers appear together as a generic dissolve.: Give each representation stage a distinct material behavior and complete one milestone before the next begins.
- The support or camera drifts during creation.: Lock framing, shadows, surface texture and prior marks; permit motion only inside active drawing regions.

templates.creative_dna:
Reusable Creative DNA (mechanism and production grammar only):
In a fixed layered composition, establish one readable background state, move one foreground effector along a clean path until it visually aligns with the target, change exactly one target state during that alignment, hold the new state long enough to read, then clear the effector and finish by recalling or acknowledging the persistent result.
Invariants:
- inv-01: Establish one stable subject-target geography and one readable baseline state before the effector enters.
- inv-02: Use one unambiguous effector path that ends in a clean foreground-to-background alignment with the target.
- inv-03: Change exactly one target state during or immediately after the alignment, without asserting literal contact that is not shown.
- inv-04: Hold the aligned effector and changed state together, then clear the effector while the result persists.
- inv-05: End on the persistent changed state with one brief acknowledgment or recall gesture, not a second state change.
Variable slots:
- foreground_subject: One original subject with a clearly readable effector and stable identity.
- background_target: One original target whose baseline and changed states are visually distinct.
- effector_path: One clean trajectory ending at a precise apparent alignment.
- state_pair: One before state and one after state; no additional state family.
- depth_grammar: A composition that keeps foreground effector, subject and rear target simultaneously legible.
- confirmation_hold: Enough time to read both aligned action and changed result.
- release_or_recall: Clear the target once, then optionally acknowledge the unchanged result.
- sound_family: Original physical cues for approach, state change, hold and release.
Failure prevention:
- The target state is not readable before the gesture.: Hold one high-contrast baseline state before the effector enters.
- The effector overlaps several controls or follows an ambiguous path.: Use one target and one clean vector ending in precise alignment.
- Several background elements change together.: Change exactly one declared state pair and freeze all other anchors.
- The hand or tool never clears the result.: After the joint confirmation hold, retract it so the changed state can be read independently.
- The ending triggers a second state change.: Use only an acknowledgment gesture or light sweep while preserving the confirmed state.

templates.creative_dna:
Reusable Creative DNA (mechanism and production grammar only):
Establish one original small moving carrier with a readable heading, speed cue and trail before an environmental anomaly is legible. Use one continuous camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut, keeping the carrier and anomaly in the same coordinate relationship as more environment enters the frame. Let the anomaly evolve from an ambiguous dark or geometric texture into a coherent hazard that occupies progressively more of the composition, while the carrier remains the stable scale unit. End on a held pre-impact or threshold state before the carrier disappears. The reusable mechanism is moving scale anchor, uninterrupted context expansion, ambiguity-to-hazard reveal and critical-distance hold—not the source wooden ship, sail, ocean, whirlpool, Odyssey claim, exact camera path, water physics, palette, watermark, creator identity or timing.
Invariants:
- inv-01: Establish one small moving carrier with heading, speed cue and trail before the anomaly is legible.
- inv-02: Use one uninterrupted camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut.
- inv-03: Keep carrier and anomaly in one coordinate relationship as the frame expands.
- inv-04: Grow the anomaly from ambiguous texture into a coherent hazard occupying more of the frame.
- inv-05: Hold before impact or disappearance with the carrier still readable.
Variable slots:
- lead_subject: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.
- setting: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.
- escalation_variable: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.
- performance_rule: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

- payoff: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

Failure prevention:
- Without a moving anchor, the hazard's size and distance remain abstract.: Establish one small moving carrier with heading, speed cue and trail before the anomaly is legible.
- A cut can fake scale and break the promised continuous observation.: Use one uninterrupted camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut.
- Reframing them independently removes spatial causality.: Keep carrier and anomaly in one coordinate relationship as the frame expands.
- Showing the full hazard immediately removes the escalation.: Grow the anomaly from ambiguous texture into a coherent hazard occupying more of the frame.
- Losing the carrier prevents verification of the critical distance.: Hold before impact or disappearance with the carrier still readable.

Authority: T8 original case template (non-official).

MECHANISM:
A visible foreground controller establishes a fixed four-direction screen-space language; a co-visible responder begins one matching full-body movement within the same beat for every cue, and repeated axis alternation lets the audience learn and verify the causal rule inside one continuous frame.

INVARIANTS:
1. The visible controller and full responder must be co-visible before the first command and remain jointly readable throughout.
2. Use one fixed screen-coordinate mapping: up means rise, down means lower, left means shift left and right means shift right.
3. Each deliberate cue receives one immediate beat-level response; the responder does not freestyle between commands.

Reusable Creative DNA (mechanism and production grammar only):
A clearly adult identity remains locked while action-led foreground carriers rotate through multiple coordinated fashion-and-graphic worlds; visual density climbs to overload, abruptly resets to a sparse full-character interval, then prior states return as a compact collage recap before one simple hero wordmark closes the campaign.
Invariants:
- inv-01: Lock one clearly adult original character with at least three stable identity anchors before the first style switch, and preserve those anchors through every wardrobe and layout module.
- inv-02: Every style module must change at least two coordinated channels among wardrobe, palette, layout, prop system and camera duty; a palette swap alone does not count.
- inv-03: Use visible foreground objects, graphic edges or character gestures as motivated handoffs between modules so action, camera and graphic transition occur in the same beat.
- inv-04: Escalate visual and typographic density to one peak, then insert a substantially sparser full-character interval before the recap.
- inv-05: After the reset, visibly recap at least three earlier states as image fragments or registered panels before resolving to one simple hero lockup.
- inv-06: Limit each module to one short original copy unit and preserve a clear subject-copy hierarchy, especially in the held final frame.
Variable slots:
- adult_identity: One original clearly adult subject with at least three stable face, hair, silhouette or accessory anchors.
- style_modules: At least four worlds that each change two or more coordinated channels, not palette alone.
- transition_carriers: Foreground props, graphic edges, fabric, gestures or registered panels that motivate each handoff.
- density_peak: The highest-load module where movement, copy and graphic layers converge without hiding identity.
- sparse_reset: A full-character low-density interval with restrained camera and effects.
- recap_system: Contact sheets, specimen cards, panels or fragments that visibly quote at least three earlier states.
- copy_units: One original short word or phrase per module, plus one simple final name hierarchy.
- hero_lockup: A held final frame that resolves the stable subject, campaign name and one concise proposition.
- sound_arc: Original modular beat families, a restrained reset texture and a decisive return cue; complete silence is optional, not required.
Failure prevention:
- Character identity drifts between style modules.: Declare three identity anchors, restate them in every module and include one explicit multi-panel verification before the density peak.

Authority: non-official, user-contributed community Skill.

# Natural Street Interaction — Skill 摘要

> **分类：非官方 · 用户贡献。** 本 Skill 由用户提供的 AIGC 样片与提示词组启发，经独立拆解、时长校正和双模型重写形成；不是 MiniMax 或 ByteDance 官方 Skill。

## 一句话机制

在连续的真实街道路线中，让镜头与人物边走边交流；人物的距离、视线、步速与手势逐步缩短社交距离，环境视差、树影和现场声同时证明空间真实，最终落到一个清楚且自然的互动结果。

## 风格

- 竖屏、第一人称、纪实街拍与轻微手机手持感
- 单一路线上的跟拍或倒退拍摄，不靠无意义快切制造热闹
- 自然光穿过树叶或建筑缝隙，在人物与背景上连续移动
- 表演以目光、呼吸、步态、微表情和手势为主
- 现场环境声优先；对白短、轮次清楚、不过载

## 适用范围

- 街头采访、偶遇、搭讪式剧情、城市漫步和人物介绍
- 服装、美妆、生活方式、旅行或城市氛围短片
- 有单人参考图、需要保持身份与服装稳定的 Ref2VA / 多模态参考
- 4–15 秒内可以由一个连续动作链讲清的互动

## 不适用范围

- 大段口播、超过五轮的复杂辩论或需要字幕解释的知识内容
- 多地点、多人物群戏、精密舞蹈或大量硬切覆盖镜头
- 未经明确要求的陌生人强行肢体接触
- 需要逐帧复刻某个真人、具体地点、穿搭或原对白的请求

## 使用方法

1. 明确互动目的、目标时长、画幅、人物关系、场景路线和结尾。
2. 如果有素材，给每张图或视频分配唯一角色：身份、服装、环境、动作或声音。
3. 先写“接近—交流—关系变化—落点”的因果链，再决定是否需要切镜。
4. 按时长删减对白：10 秒优先 2–3 句短对白；15 秒也不要机械塞满台词。
5. 分别使用 H3 与 Seedance 模板编译，不能在两种模型之间复制语法。
6. 检查身份、步态、路线、光影、手部接触、声音与时间是否闭合。

## 可变槽位

| 槽位 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `social_premise` | 偶遇、采访、认出、问路、展示、邀请或道别 |
| `on_camera_subject` | 身份、两三个稳定外观锚点、服装与当前情绪 |
| `interviewer_role` | 画外摄影师、同行者、店主、朋友或路人 |
| `route_geometry` | 直行、侧向并行、拐角会合、短暂停步后继续 |
| `distance_change` | 从远到近、并肩、停下、转身或保持礼貌距离 |
| `gesture_chain` | 目光、整理衣物、指向、递物、示范或告别 |
| `camera_follow` | 倒退跟拍、侧向并行、短暂定住、轻微重构图 |
| `light_behavior` | 树影、橱窗反射、建筑阴影或云层变化 |
| `dialogue` | 用户确认的短句、语言、说话顺序与停顿 |
| `resolved_state` | 许可、姿势、展示、路线、反应或自然离场 |

## 核心质量门

- 第二个事件不能从目标时长终点才开始。
- 镜头运动必须由人物路线或视线驱动。
- 触碰必须有动机、双方可读且不会产生手臂穿插。
- 不把“4K、超高清、电影感”当作缺少动作与空间设计的替代品。
- 样片只提供机制证据；人物外貌、服装、城市、对白和构图不属于可复制模板。

更深入的不变量、消融解释、转移测试和失败修复见 [template.md](./template.md)。

# MiniMax H3 template

Use the Base form when there are no generation-time references. Use Ref2VA only when the user actually supplies an image or video that must control identity, wardrobe, scene, motion, or sound.

## Ref2VA skeleton

```text
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the on-camera [role] whose identity, facial structure, hairstyle, body proportions, and [wardrobe anchor] come from <Picture 1>. Preserve natural skin texture and the same outfit throughout.
<Picture 1> is the identity and wardrobe reference for <Subject 1>; it is not a mandatory first frame.

summary:
[reference generation] Create a [TARGET_DURATION]-second [ASPECT_RATIO] documentary street interaction in which <Subject 1> [one-sentence social premise and resolved state].

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — preserve identity, proportions, hairstyle, and wardrobe while allowing natural walking, speaking, gaze, and gestures.
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer — transfer identity and wardrobe only; rebuild the street, route, framing, lighting, and action as an original scene.

detailed_description:
Natural vertical street-documentary image quality, realistic skin and fabric response, coherent background parallax, and restrained handheld motion. No unsupported resolution claim.

[Shot 1] A first-person camera [backpedals / side-walks] at [framing] on an original [street setting]. <Subject 1> begins [opening action] at [opening distance]. [Moving daylight behavior] crosses both the subject and the street; [foreground/background anchors] shift with continuous parallax. The off-screen interviewer (S1) says <d>[Chinese][SHORT LINE 1]</d>. <Subject 1> (S2) looks toward the lens, [micro-performance], and replies <d>[Chinese][SHORT LINE 2]</d>. Their steps remain synchronized with the route, with realistic foot contact and small step-linked camera sway.

[Optional Shot 2] At [MM:SS.mmm below the target duration], [only if a genuine event boundary is needed]. <Subject 1> [visible relationship-changing action] while the camera [one motivated reframe]. (S1) says <d>[Chinese][OPTIONAL SHORT LINE 3]</d>. (S2) [gesture or gaze response] and replies <d>[Chinese][OPTIONAL SHORT LINE 4]</d>. The action resolves as [permission / pose / reveal / route choice / natural release], held long enough to read before the video ends. Do not begin a new setup at the endpoint.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous location ambience from [street sound family], soft synchronized footsteps, fabric movement, and only the physical sounds caused by visible actions. Dialogue is not repeated here. No abrupt ambience reset across the optional cut.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

Delete the optional shot when the scene is a single continuous event. Define only labels that correspond to real generation-time inputs, and include exactly one retention line per independent label.

```text
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A [TARGET_DURATION]-second [ASPECT_RATIO] original street-documentary scene. [Stable subject appearance], [social premise], [one route], [one primary camera follow], [performance progression], [moving daylight and parallax], [approved dialogue with speaker IDs and <d> blocks], and [readable resolved state].

overall_soundscape: [Continuous location ambience, synchronized footsteps and action foley, no repeated dialogue.]

non_diegetic_music: N/A
```

## Single continuous interaction

```text
[TARGET_DURATION]秒，[ASPECT_RATIO]。角色A@[图片1，如有]是一位[人物身份与两三个稳定外观锚点]，始终保持同一发型、身材比例和[服装锚点]。在原创的[街道与时段]，第一人称手持镜头以[倒退跟拍/侧向并行]保持[景别]，角色A从[起始距离]沿[路线几何]自然接近；脚步带来轻微而克制的纵向起伏，[前景物/背景线条]持续产生真实视差，[树影/橱窗反射/建筑阴影]同时掠过人物和环境，曝光只做轻微自然适应。画外采访者问{短句1}，角色A看向镜头，以[目光、呼吸、步态或手势]回应{短句2}；随后通过[距离、速度、身体角度或共享物体的变化]推进关系，并在结尾落到[许可、姿势、展示、路线选择、反应或自然离场]，停留到状态可读。<连续街道环境声、同步脚步、衣料和可见动作声>。约束：身份与服装稳定，路线和光向连续，手脚接触可信，无多余人物复制，无字幕Logo水印，不出现未经要求的音乐，不从片尾才开始新镜头。
```

没有图片时删除 `@图片1`，不要保留空引用。若使用图片，在资产职责中写明：`图片1只提供角色A的身份与服装，不提供原场景、构图或动作。`

## Multi-shot variant

只在确有切镜时使用连续 `镜头N`，不要写逐镜头秒数：

```text
总时长约[TARGET_DURATION]秒，[ASPECT_RATIO]。角色A@图片1保持[身份锚点和服装]；图片1只提供身份与服装。
镜头1：[原创街道、起始距离、社会前提、第一句短对白、主要跟拍方式、环境视差与光线]
镜头2：[由视线、停步、转身或共享物体驱动的必要重构图；第二组短对白与可见关系变化]
镜头3：[可读的最终状态与短暂停留，不开启新的故事线]
<统一地点环境声、同步脚步与动作声>。约束：[身份、服装、空间、接触、文字和反复制边界]
```

## Seedance audit

- Overall duration is 4–15 seconds; there are no exact per-shot timestamps.
- Every `图片N/视频N/音频N` reference resolves and has one narrow role.
- Dialogue uses `{...}`; physical sound uses `<...>`; music uses `（...）`; visible copy uses `【...】` only when requested.
- No H3 field names, `<Subject N>`, `[Shot N]`, speaker IDs, or `<d>` blocks appear.
- The prompt changes the sample's person, outfit, city surface, dialogue, route, framing, and ending.

# Startle-to-Truce Encounter — Skill 摘要

> **分类：非官方 · 用户贡献。** 本 Skill 由用户提供的 AIGC 样片与提示词文本启发，经完整解码、逐段画面核对、时长修复和双模型重写形成；不是 MiniMax 或 ByteDance 官方 Skill。

## 一句话机制

让一个平静主体被技术观察者发现，通过双方视角建立认知差；一次非致命惊慌反应把距离推到极端，主体再以不可能的近距离同框反转空间权力，最后用持续对视和一个迟疑手势尝试把威胁降级，但不虚构双方已经和解。

## 推荐简写输入

把下面这一段替换槽位后直接放入提示词增强器，比复制整篇样片提示词更稳定：

```text
15秒，16:9。[平静主角]被[技术观察者]意外发现；双方通过独立视角建立距离。观察者因主角突然贴近[舷窗/观察窗/透明屏障]而做一次非致命惊慌反应，主角保持克制并与其准确对视。结尾由观察者迟疑地做出求和手势，主角以停留、轻微表情或小幅回应让关系降级。保持身份、载具、屏障、速度、光向和视线连续；不受伤，不堆叠武器，不加字幕Logo水印。
```

如使用参考图，再加一句：

```text
图片1只锁定角色A的身份、脸型、发型与服装，不继承原图场景、构图、姿势或首帧。
```

## 风格与适用范围

- 幻想主体与现代科技、自然生物与研究设备、微缩生命与控制室之间的反差相遇
- 驾驶舱、潜航器、观察窗、温室玻璃、实验舱或透明屏障两侧的精准对视
- 4–15 秒内可讲清的追近、惊吓、误判、试探与非语言和解
- 需要参考图锁定单一角色身份、但必须重建场景和动作的 H3 Ref2VA 或 Seedance 多模态参考
- 靠眼神、肩颈、握力、手势和相对速度完成的轻喜剧或温和戏剧反转

## 不适用范围

- 需要完整战争、多人战术、连续爆炸和复杂武器逻辑的动作大片
- 把受伤、血腥或真实攻击作为必要卖点的内容
- 无法给最终对视和手势留出阅读时间的过载分镜
- 只替换精灵、战机、飞剑、浮空山或水果名词的表面复刻

## 核心质量门

- 决定性贴近必须早于结尾，给受惊和求和留出时间。
- 防御动作只能按可见结构命名；看见对称光轨时不能自动写成制导导弹。
- 结尾至少证明“手势被看见”，不强行声称对方接受和解。
- 玻璃两侧必须具有正确的视线、反射、屏幕方向和匹配速度。
- 13 秒样片不能冒充精确 15 秒；生成模板可重新设计为 15 秒，但必须重新分配事件。

完整不变量、消融解释、转移测试与失败修复见 [template.md](./template.md)。

h3.guidance:
MiniMax H3 native adapter. Realize every required mechanism anchor as a concrete visible event inside the native H3 integrated description or Ref2VA detailed description. Preserve the exact H3 Base/Ref2VA field order, [Shot N] timeline, camera continuity, soundscape and music separation. Do not emit Seedance 镜头N or @图片N syntax. The case mechanism is lower priority than user intent, observable media, hard constraints, duration, fixed shot count, official H3 rules, official creative presets and a manual reference template.

# MiniMax H3 template

Use Base T2VA when there are no generation-time references. Use Ref2VA only when the user actually supplies an image or video for identity, wardrobe, scene, motion, camera, or sound.

## Recommended T2VA structure

```text
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [Original calm subject, baseline behavior, distant observer, readable separation, light and environment.] [Shot 2] At [timestamp], [observer POV inside a technical enclosure; attention shift and spatial cue.] [Shot 3] At [timestamp], [one bounded non-lethal escalation and coherent distance-closing trajectory.] [Shot 4] At [timestamp], [subject reaches the transparent boundary; matched speed, exact eyeline, observer startle.] [Shot 5] At [timestamp], [small conciliatory offer and held visible response in a shared-axis composition.]

overall_soundscape: [Continuous environment and machine ambience, synchronized movement, one escalation transient, barrier-level detail, and restrained settling sounds. Do not repeat dialogue.]

non_diegetic_music: [Optional concise audience-only score, or N/A.]
```

## Optional Ref2VA identity block

```text
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult [ROLE] whose identity, facial structure, hairstyle, body proportions, and [WARDROBE ANCHORS] come from <Picture 1>.

summary:
[reference generation] Create an original [DURATION]-second [ASPECT] startle-to-truce encounter in which <Subject 1> closes an impossible distance to a technical observer and resolves the encounter through gaze and one restrained gesture.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — preserve identity, proportions, hairstyle, and wardrobe while allowing new performance and movement.

detailed_description:
[Write original style and five evidence-bearing shots. State that <Picture 1> supplies identity and wardrobe only; rebuild setting, composition, action, observer, boundary, and lighting.]

overall_soundscape:
[Continuous ambience and synchronized physical effects; no invented dialogue.]

non_diegetic_music:
[Optional score or N/A.]
```

Do not independently define `<Picture 1>` when it is only provenance for `<Subject 1>`. Add exactly one retention line per independently defined label.

## H3 audit

- First shot has no timestamp; later timestamps increase and remain within 4–15 seconds.
- Official-strict prose is English outside approved dialogue or visible text.
- The close appearance, startle, gesture, and held response all fit before the endpoint.
- No Seedance braces, `镜头N`, or `@图片N` syntax appears.
- No research video or reference image is fabricated as a generation input.
- The output does not reproduce the demonstration's character, fruit, sword, aircraft, landscape, flare pattern, or exact canopy arrangement.

See [h3-example.txt](./h3-example.txt) for one validated original T2VA realization.

# Seedance 2.0 template

Use a multi-shot structure for the complete calm-to-truce arc. Do not copy H3 timestamps or field labels.

## Recommended structure

```text

镜头1：[平静主体、基线动作、远处观察者、可读距离与环境光影]
镜头2：[观察者独立视角、透明边界、注意力变化与空间线索]

<连续环境声、系统声、同步移动声、一次防御瞬态与结尾安静细节>。
约束：[身份、观察者、载具、边界、屏幕方向、光向和相对速度连续；非致命；无字幕Logo水印；不复制样片表面]
```

如使用图片，先写：`角色A@图片1保持[两三个身份锚点与服装]；图片1只提供身份与服装，不提供原场景、构图、动作或首帧。`

- Every `图片N/视频N/音频N` reference resolves and has one narrow role.
- Physical sound uses `<...>`; dialogue uses `{...}`; music uses `（...）`.
- No H3 fields, `[Shot N]`, speaker IDs, or `<d>` blocks appear.
